kicker.zh: 从零开始的动态规划解谜

lede.zh: 不需要任何编程或算法基础。从手数路线开始，学会把一个大问题拆成一张表，一格一格地填出来；最后能亲手拼出数路线、比文字、装背包的电路板，并且明白它们为什么这么快。
lede.en: No programming or algorithms background needed. Starting from counting routes by hand, you learn to break a big problem into a table and fill it in cell by cell; in the end you wire up the circuit boards that count routes, compare words and pack a backpack, and see why they are so fast.

desc.zh: 把两条来路的数加起来；「起点」口是「是」时，再加 1。「—」不算在内，什么都没收到时输出「—」。
desc.en: Adds up the numbers on its two ways in, plus 1 when its “start” port is “yes”. A “—” is left out; with nothing to add, it outputs “—”.

desc.zh: 每个格子都要排在它要读的格子之后。顺序反过来，电路读的方向也得跟着反过来。
desc.en: Every cell must come after the cells it reads. Reverse the order, and the directions the circuit reads must reverse too.

desc.zh: 取最多三条来路里最小的（「起点」口是「是」时，0 也算一条来路），再加上本格代价。来路全是「—」时，输出「—」。
desc.en: Takes the smallest of up to three ways in (when its “start” port is “yes”, 0 counts as a way in too), then adds this cell’s cost. When every way in is “—”, it outputs “—”.

desc.zh: 把表复制成几层，让状态多记一件会影响未来的事。
desc.en: Copy the table into several layers, so the state remembers one more thing that affects the future.

desc.zh: 一个词放上面，一个词放左边。字相同，左上 + 1；否则取上面和左边中较大的。
desc.en: One word along the top, the other down the left. If the letters match, up-left + 1; otherwise the larger of up and left.

desc.zh: 输出这几个数里最小的：上面、左边、左上三者中最小的 + 1；字相同时的左上；起点上的 0。
desc.en: Outputs the smallest of: the smallest of up, left and up-left, plus 1; up-left itself when the letters match; 0 on the start.

desc.zh: 输出「不换」和「换来 + 加上」两者中较大的那个。
desc.en: Outputs the larger of “keep” and “swap for” plus “plus”.

desc.zh: 只留一行原地改写。改写的方向，决定每件物品能用几次。
desc.en: Keep just one row and rewrite it in place. The direction you rewrite in decides how many times each item can be used.

desc.zh: 读三个对手局面：只要有一个是「输」，这一格就是「赢」；否则是「输」。
desc.en: Reads the three positions the opponent could face: if any of them is a loss, this cell is a win; otherwise a loss.

desc.zh: 一次读一整段格子。可每格都从头扫一遍很慢：能用上一格存好的答案，就别重扫。
desc.en: Reads a whole run of cells at once. But sweeping from the start on every cell is slow: if the previous cell has already stored the answer, use it instead of sweeping again.

desc.zh: 前面某个位置能切开，而且那一截刚好是个词，这里就能切开。
desc.en: If some earlier position can be split and the piece from there to here is exactly a word, this position can be split too.

desc.zh: 左段和右段是两串数：按切分点一一相加，取最小的，再加上整段代价。
desc.en: Its left and right parts are two runs of numbers: it adds them split point by split point, takes the smallest, then adds the cost of the whole run.

desc.zh: 只要每个格子都排在它要读的格子之后，什么顺序都行。
desc.en: Any order works, as long as every cell comes after the cells it reads.

desc.zh: 取最多四条来路里最大的，再乘上元件上的数（比如 0.9）。
desc.en: Takes the largest of up to four ways in, then multiplies it by the number set on its part (0.9, say).

desc.zh: 结果不确定时，把每种结果按可能性加权，再比较。
desc.en: When the outcome is uncertain, weight each outcome by how likely it is, then compare.

desc.zh: 每一列每一种标签，记下到这里最省的解释：上一列各行加上转移代价，取较小。
desc.en: For every tag in every column, keep the cheapest explanation up to here: each row of the previous column plus its transition cost, then the min.

desc.zh: 低于 0 就截成 0：重新开始，比背着负分走下去强。答案在表里最大的那一格。
desc.en: Anything below 0 is cut to 0: starting afresh beats carrying a negative score along. The answer is the largest cell in the table.

desc.zh: 每一格 = 本格能量 + 上面三格里最小的。从最底一行最小的格子倒推，剪掉这条缝。
desc.en: Each cell = its own energy + the smallest of the three cells above it. Trace back from the smallest cell in the bottom row, and cut that seam out.

desc.zh: 用小问题的答案，拼出大问题的答案。
desc.en: Build the answer to a big problem out of the answers to small ones.

desc.zh: 机器人在每一格上运行同一块电路板；拼好的电路板会变成元件。
desc.en: On every cell the robot runs the same circuit board, and a finished board becomes a component.

desc.zh: 在一张图里，找一条最不起眼的缝。
desc.en: Find the least noticeable seam in a picture.

desc.zh: 看得更远：两步之外的格子；看得更全：表头上的两个词；还能换个方向扫。
desc.en: It sees further, two cells away; it sees more, the two words a table compares; and it can scan the other way round.

desc.zh: 输错一个词，找出词典里最接近的那个。
desc.en: A word is mistyped: find the closest one in the dictionary.

desc.zh: 伸缩臂能够到任意远的一格。
desc.en: A telescopic arm reaches a cell however far away.

desc.zh: 容量有限，拿什么最值钱？
desc.en: With limited room, what is most worth taking?

desc.zh: 扫描臂扫过一整段格子，来路的数量不再固定。
desc.en: The sweep arm passes over a whole run of cells, so the number of ways in is no longer fixed.

desc.zh: 一串没有空格的字母，切成词典里的词。
desc.en: A string with no spaces, cut into dictionary words.

desc.zh: 一个数记不住的时候，就多记一件事。
desc.en: When one number can’t remember enough, remember one more thing.

desc.zh: 该记住什么，这次由你决定。
desc.en: This time, you decide what to remember.

desc.zh: 箭头绕成了圈，就一遍一遍地扫。
desc.en: When the arrows loop round, scan again and again.

desc.zh: 机器人在格子里找宝藏，越远的宝藏越不值钱。
desc.en: The robot hunts for treasure on a grid, and the further it is, the less it is worth.
